Home/Solutions/Invote

Remote voting

InvoteOnline voting

Online voting software for remote elections. It enables secure, auditable voting from anywhere.

With Invote, voters can cast their ballot from any connected device, anywhere. Organizations and governments use it to broaden participation and reach voters who live far away or abroad.

Secure

Built under a management system certified to ISO/IEC 27001 and ISO/IEC 27701.

Scalable

Ready for processes of any size, from a single institution to an entire country.

Auditable

Every operation leaves a record and can be independently verified.
